Last night the people of the Twin Cities received the JFK Profile in Courage Award. It was an inspiration to be there as Imam Yusuf Abdulle, Natalie Ehret, Carolina Ortiz, and Zena Stenvik accepted the award. 

As Yusuf said: “I encourage everybody to choose to be brave.” That's what Minnesotans did.

Video

The people of the Twin Cities win the JFK Profile in Courage award. Thanks to Amb. Caroline Kennedy for the amazing evening and Yusuf, Carolina, Zena & Natalie who accepted the award and represented our State so well at the ceremony!  ❤️

A beautiful story of the Annunciation students and community coming together to fish in honor of their friend Fletcher.

The people of the Twin Cities are being awarded the John F. Kennedy Profile in Courage Award tonight.

This winter, Minnesotans showed the world what courage looks like. Our state was the center of America's heartbreak, but we were also the center of America's hope.

I know who I am, and I know who I am running for: the people of Minnesota.

Video

The Kennedy Center belongs to the people.

As the judge wrote: “Congress gave the Kennedy Center its name, and only Congress can change it.”

Honored to earn the endorsement of the Minnesota DFL alongside former Fergus Falls Mayor Ben Schierer.

We are ready to hit the campaign trail!

Video

The sun was shining in Plymouth today for the Twin Cities West Metro Asian Fair.

Great to see so many people come together to celebrate Asian culture, heritage, and food.

It takes a team, and I’m lucky to have this one.

Video
I am honored to have the DFL endorsement and ready to get to work!

Ben Schierer will make a great Lieutenant Governor. He has a long history of serving his community in Fergus Falls, and he’s a proven leader in economic development in rural Minnesota.

He will be a great partner to work with me on moving Minnesota forward.

Today I'm excited to announce my running mate for Lieutenant Governor: former Fergus Falls Mayor Ben Schierer.

Ben hasn’t just talked about how to create opportunities in greater Minnesota – he’s actually done it.

He knows what it takes to run a small business – he’s run two of them. He knows what it takes to get results by bringing people together – because that’s what he did as mayor.

Together we’ll bring that energy to every corner of Minnesota.

Video

Prices continue to rise and paychecks can’t keep up. 

President Trump’s tariffs and war with Iran are driving up costs and the American people are paying the price.

I was in Blaine for the Highway 65 Reconstruction Project groundbreaking. These four highway overpasses (combo of state, federal & local funding) will finally & vastly improve one of the most dangerous stretches of road in Minnesota. Less congestion, less traffic lights and safe driving. YES!

Video

Rochester Airport continues to keep up with the times and it is an airport that receives life-saving organs and equipment every day. 

We got federal funding for an upgrade that will improve safety and support cargo, air ambulances, pilot training, and local businesses.

Video

Honored to receive the endorsement of the Minnesota AFL-CIO. I come from a Union family. The unions made the mines safe where my grandpa worked. Both my mom and dad belonged to unions. 

When unions are strong, our economy is strong. When our economy is strong, America is strong.

Tariffs and global instability are driving up fertilizer costs for Minnesota farmers. I was in Mankato because some of the biggest innovations are happening right here: converting local biofuels into domestically sourced fertilizer, creating jobs, and cutting dependence on China.

Video

On this Eid al-Adha, I’m thinking of Minnesota’s Muslim community and all those gathered in prayer today, especially following today’s tragic shooting at an Eid prayer service at Canterbury Park.

My thoughts are with the victim's family and the entire community.

Was in Rochester today for the groundbreaking on Rochester International Airport's General Aviation ramp. I worked to secure federal funding to break ground on this project that will modernize aging infrastructure and improve airport safety. ✈️
